regime_context: The detector shows Big Banks as the dominant theme with broad breadth, mixed trend health, and crowded conditions. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped cut drawdowns in this market (gate_helps: true). Eligible themes span Financials, Energy, Utilities, and some Materials; multiple ineligible themes (Gold Miners, Telecom, Technology) exhibit poor trend health. Momentum ranks carry no forward return edge, and there is no confirmed rotation signal.
emerging_watch: Watch Big Banks (ZEB.TO) for potential leadership fatigue: if durability drops below 0.6 and breadth narrows below 0.8, the trend may be ending. Kill-criterion: durability recovers above 0.7.
